title: When the Visitor Burns
author: H. M. Pemberton
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
